title: CatalogDependency
responsibility: Stores directed unit relationships in catalog_dependencies through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogDependency.id
inputs.description: Required string row key included in create attributes and passed to find, update, and delete; the model does not generate, normalize, or validate it.

inputs.name: CatalogDependency.entityId
inputs.description: Required string field in each CatalogDependencyAttributes row and create input; the model forwards it without resolving or validating it.

inputs.name: CatalogDependency.targetId
inputs.description: Required string field in each CatalogDependencyAttributes row and create input; the model forwards it without parsing or validating it.

inputs.name: CatalogDependency.via
inputs.description: Required string field in each CatalogDependencyAttributes row and create input; the model forwards it without interpreting or validating it.

outputs.name: CatalogDependency.find
outputs.description: Resolves to the adapter row for the supplied id, or null, and is used for key lookup. The model returns the adapter result directly without validating or transforming it.

outputs.name: CatalogDependency.findBy
outputs.description: Resolves to the array returned by adapter.findBy for a shallow copy of the supplied partial fields. The model does not sort, validate, or otherwise transform the rows.

outputs.name: CatalogDependency.create
outputs.description: Resolves to the row returned by adapter.create after the input is shallow-copied for insertion. The model does not generate an id, validate fields, or post-process the result.

outputs.name: CatalogDependency.update
outputs.description: Resolves to the updated row returned by adapter.update, or null. The key and shallow-copied partial patch are passed through without model-side validation or defaulting.

outputs.name: CatalogDependency.delete
outputs.description: Resolves to the boolean returned by adapter.delete for the supplied id. The model does not reinterpret the deletion result.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous adapter exceptions and rejections from adapter promises pass through unchanged; getters that throw while findBy, create, or update copies an argument also escape. The model does not catch or wrap these failures.
